title: Swarm Topology
intro: Mythos Swarm maps the OpenMythos RDT (Recurrent-Depth Transformer) three-stage topology to a Multica squad: the prelude agent plans the work, N parallel loop agents iterate (cosine ≥ 0.95 = convergence), and the coda agent synthesizes the final conclusion. Each loop turn is encouraged to consult the lab's skills through the SkillAdapter. The model is always Multica's — no extra dependency.
flag_off_notice: The Mythos Swarm flag is currently off. Once it is enabled, the page shows the 5 Mythos agents + 1 squad roster plus a live run form.
bullet1: Pick extra agents to join the loop rotation (this is the only lab that allows a free agent picker).
bullet2: Turn on self-optimization so the coda agent writes a per-iteration reflection comment.
bullet3: Encourage the loop agents to read specific skills via the SkillAdapter.
roster_blurb: Provisioned by the mythos_swarm flag. Your existing squads and agents are not touched.
run_form_blurb: Submit a problem to the swarm. The runner blocks on the daemon until each loop iter's sub-issue closes (max 60 s / iter).
field_problem_placeholder: What should the swarm work on?
field_max_iters_help: Clamped to 1..5 by the server's hard-cap ceiling (mythos.MaxLoopItersHardCap).
field_extension_agents_help: Appended to the canonical 3-agent loop rotation. Max 8, dedupe by UUID. The runner falls back to the canonical roster when this list is empty.
no_extension_candidates: No eligible agents in this workspace.
field_self_optimization_help: After each loop iter the coda agent writes a reflection comment on the sub-issue. Reflection count is shown in the result card.
field_skills_help: The first 3 names are baked into the loop sub-issue description. Longer lists are truncated.
